PROBLEM: Agent working memory is an undifferentiated text blob: no budgets, no mutability labels, no structure for self-editing.
MECHANISM: In-context memory is a list of labeled Blocks (label, value, description, char limit, read_only). Rendered into the system prompt inside <memory_blocks> with <description>, <metadata> (chars_current/chars_limit/read_only), <value> tags, so the agent sees its own memory budget and mutability. Agent edits via tools: core_memory_append, core_memory_replace, memory_apply_patch, memory_rethink, memory_str_replace. ContextWindowOverview types the full context budget (system, core, archival, recall, summary, filesystem, tools).
INVARIANT: Every in-context memory unit carries its identity (label), budget (limit), and mutability (read_only); renders are deterministic from block list.
FAILURE_MODEL: Edit tools raise on read_only blocks (READ_ONLY_BLOCK_EDIT_ERROR) and on exact-match miss (core_memory_replace); no silent overwrite.
SECURITY_MODEL: read_only blocks are non-editable by the agent; block labels are validated unique; file_blocks dedup validator strips duplicate labels with a logged warning.
SCALING_MODEL: O(n) blocks rendered per prompt; char limits bound total size; archival paging (see LETTA-ARCHIVAL-PAGING) overflows to external store.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX workers have no memory in the execution path (proven gap). Blocks map to a worker-scoped working-context assembly rendered from typed memory records, with budgets enforced by the canonicalization authority.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Working context becomes a typed, budgeted, agent-editable structure instead of an opaque prompt blob; edits are auditable events.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: new worker-context assembly + block tool surface on MissionRuntime.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: gives workers self-managed bounded working memory, the prerequisite for all other memory ops.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: Check letta/schemas/memory.py Memory class has Block list with limit/read_only and _render_memory_blocks_* methods; check core_tool_executor.py raises READ_ONLY_BLOCK_EDIT_ERROR.

PROBLEM: LLM-driven memory edits silently overwrite or partially match content, corrupting curated memory.
MECHANISM: core_memory_replace(label, old_content, new_content): reads current value; if old_content is not present verbatim, raises ValueError naming the missing content and block; else performs replacement and persists via update_memory_if_changed_async. memory_replace additionally rejects old_string containing line-number prefixes (the render artifact) so the agent cannot corrupt memory with display formatting.
INVARIANT: A replace either applies to an exactly-matched substring or fails loudly; memory never partially updates.
FAILURE_MODEL: Typed ValueError on miss or on line-number-prefix contamination; caller (agent loop) sees the error and retries.
SECURITY_MODEL: read_only blocks reject all edits; exact-match prevents the model from rewriting adjacent content it did not intend to touch.
SCALING_MODEL: O(block length) string scan; trivial cost.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX canonical workers reify results as canonical events; a memory-edit worker must use exact-match semantics so an agent cannot silently rewrite approved memory (directly addresses the re-emission-demotes-approved-nodes gap pattern).
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory mutation becomes an explicit, verifiable, fail-closed operation rather than a blind overwrite.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: adopt exact-match + read_only guard in any memory write tool.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: prevents the most common memory corruption mode (silent partial overwrite).
FALSIFICATION_TEST: In letta/services/tool_executor/core_tool_executor.py, core_memory_replace raises ValueError when old_content not in current_value; memory_replace raises on MEMORY_TOOLS_LINE_NUMBER_PREFIX_REGEX match.

PROBLEM: Multi-hunk memory edits via whole-block rewrite are lossy and race-prone; append/replace are too coarse.
MECHANISM: memory_apply_patch(label, patch): applies a unified-diff patch to a memory block value with a deterministic applier (find_all_subseq subsequence matching, extended-patch detection, flush_action sequencing). Gives agents git-style surgical edits over working memory.
INVARIANT: Patch application is deterministic: same (value, patch) -> same result or a typed failure; no LLM judgment in the apply step.
FAILURE_MODEL: Patch that does not match fails with an error naming the mismatch; no partial application.
SECURITY_MODEL: Same read_only guard as other edit tools; patch is data, applied by deterministic code, never executed.
SCALING_MODEL: O(value lines x patch hunks); fine for KB-scale blocks.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX already treats patches as typed artifacts (FYD typed SiteSpec patches); the same discipline applies to memory: agent proposes patch, deterministic code applies, failure is typed.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory edits become reviewable diffs rather than opaque rewrites.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: port the deterministic patch applier.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: surgical edits reduce accidental memory damage vs full-block rewrite.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: memory_apply_patch exists in core_tool_executor.py with apply_unified_patch_to_value and find_all_subseq helpers.

PROBLEM: Working context is finite; the agent needs unbounded recall it manages itself instead of system-managed truncation.
MECHANISM: Two tools: archival_memory_insert(content, tags) persists passages to an embedding-indexed external store; archival_memory_search(query, tags, tag_match_mode any/all, top_k, start_datetime, end_datetime) lets the agent self-direct paging with tag + temporal filters. Recall memory (conversation_search) is the temporal counterpart over message history. The agent decides what to page in/out, when.
INVARIANT: Working context stays bounded; anything evicted remains retrievable by the agent through explicit search calls.
FAILURE_MODEL: Search returns ranked passages or empty; insert persists and rebuilds the system prompt (rebuild_system_prompt_async force=True).
SECURITY_MODEL: Archival store is per-agent (agent_id scoped); tags are agent-assigned metadata.
SCALING_MODEL: Vector search over per-agent passage store; bounded by top_k.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX subagents are disposable with no transcript inheritance; an archival paging discipline gives a mission a bounded working set plus agent-driven recall over the event journal instead of dumping full history into workers.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory overflow becomes an agent-managed operation (explicit search/insert calls) rather than invisible truncation.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: per-mission passage store + two worker tools.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: the classic solution to context-window pressure; keeps workers small.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: core_tool_executor.py defines archival_memory_search with tags/tag_match_mode/top_k/start_datetime/end_datetime params and archival_memory_insert calling passage_manager.insert_passage.

PROBLEM: Memory edits destroy history: a correction overwrites the record it corrects, so disputes and rollbacks are impossible.
MECHANISM: GitEnabledBlockManager: when an agent carries the git-memory-enabled tag, all block writes go to git first (source of truth, full version history), PostgreSQL is synced as a read cache. get_block_at_commit and get_block_history give point-in-time memory reads; sync_blocks_from_git repairs cache drift.
INVARIANT: Every memory state is recoverable by commit; the cache never invents a state git does not have.
FAILURE_MODEL: If git is unavailable the manager degrades to standard BlockManager behavior (git features disabled, not failed writes).
SECURITY_MODEL: Version history is append-only in git; no destructive rewrite path exposed to the agent.
SCALING_MODEL: Reads served from PG cache; git history grows linearly with edits; per-agent opt-in via tag.
CRX_ANALOG: Directly addresses CRX's 'correction survival broken (re-emission demotes approved nodes)' gap: corrections become new commits; approved nodes are never demoted by re-emission because history is the authority.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory becomes a versioned, auditable, rollback-capable record instead of a mutable blob.
INTEGRATION_COST: High: git/object-store backend + cache-sync discipline per memory scope.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Very high: fixes correction survival, the exact gap CRX's audit named.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: letta/services/block_manager_git.py exists with GitEnabledBlockManager, get_block_at_commit, get_block_history, and the 'write to git first, sync PG as cache' docstring.

PROBLEM: Facts change over time; deleting the old fact destroys the evidence needed to understand what was true when, and concurrent corrections race.
MECHANISM: EntityEdge carries valid_at (when the fact became true), invalid_at (when it stopped being true), expired_at (when invalidated), created_at. resolve_edge_contradictions applies pure timestamp logic: if a new edge contradicts an existing one and new.valid_at > old.valid_at with overlapping windows, the old edge is stamped invalid_at=new.valid_at, expired_at=now(). Old facts are never deleted; current truth is derived by filtering on validity windows.
INVARIANT: Supersession is append-only: contradiction resolves to timestamp stamps, never to mutation or deletion of the old edge.
FAILURE_MODEL: Deterministic (no LLM in the invalidation step); window-overlap edge cases are skipped (continue) rather than force-resolved.
SECURITY_MODEL: Invalidation requires a contradicting edge produced through the same extraction pipeline; no direct timestamp writes exposed.
SCALING_MODEL: Per-ingestion cost is bounded by candidate edges between the same node pair plus hybrid-search candidates.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX is event-sourced with causation/correlation lineage: bi-temporal invalidation maps to superseding events that stamp prior knowledge without rewriting history — the event journal stays the source truth, derived projections compute 'current'.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Corrections stop destroying evidence; 'what is true now' becomes a deterministic function of the edge history.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: bi-temporal fields on knowledge records + deterministic invalidation pass on write.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Very high: the strongest correction/contradiction mechanism found in any source.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: graphiti_core/edges.py EntityEdge has valid_at/invalid_at/expired_at fields; edge_operations.py resolve_edge_contradictions sets edge.invalid_at = resolved_edge.valid_at and never deletes.

PROBLEM: Naive dedup conflates 'same fact restated' with 'fact updated' — merging a correction as a duplicate silently drops the update.
MECHANISM: The dedupe_edges LLM prompt returns two separate lists: duplicate_facts (identical factual information) and contradicted_facts (same relationship, new information supersedes). Example baked into the prompt: updated job title -> contradiction, NOT a duplicate. Duplicates are linked via IS_DUPLICATE_OF; contradictions flow to temporal invalidation.
INVARIANT: Classification distinguishes identity from succession before any write decision is made.
FAILURE_MODEL: LLM misclassification is bounded: worst case a contradiction is treated as duplicate (linked, not deleted) or vice versa (old edge stamped, still recoverable).
SECURITY_MODEL: Classification output is constrained to index lists over provided candidates; the model cannot invent edges.
SCALING_MODEL: One LLM call per edge batch; candidates pre-filtered by hybrid search.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX write qualification: any memory admission pipeline should classify new-vs-duplicate-vs-contradiction as three distinct outcomes with different downstream effects.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Dedup stops being a binary decision; succession is handled explicitly.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: adopt the two-list classification contract in any LLM dedup step.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: prevents the silent-drop-of-updates failure mode.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: graphiti_core/prompts/dedupe_edges.py defines contradicted_facts and duplicate_facts as separate fields with the updated-title example.

PROBLEM: Ingestion pipelines need to know what was new, what was duplicate, and what was invalidated — a single 'written' signal hides the interesting outcomes.
MECHANISM: resolve_extracted_edges returns (resolved_edges, invalidated_edges, new_edges). Within-batch exact dedup on normalized (source, target, fact) key; Redis dedup cache covers recently-resolved edges not yet visible in graph indexes (pipeline-race consistency); filter_existing_duplicate_of_edges skips pairs already linked IS_DUPLICATE_OF.
INVARIANT: Every extracted edge lands in exactly one of the three buckets; duplicates and invalidations are observable outputs, not hidden side effects.
FAILURE_MODEL: Redis cache is a best-effort accelerator; correctness does not depend on it (graph remains the authority).
SECURITY_MODEL: Dedup keys are content-derived; no user-controlled identifiers in the dedup path.
SCALING_MODEL: Candidate retrieval per edge is top-k bounded; exact-key dedup is O(batch).
CRX_ANALOG: CRX workers reify results as canonical events: a memory-ingestion worker should emit the triple as typed events (OBSERVED/DEDUPLICATED/INVALIDATED) so projections and audits can distinguish the outcomes.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Ingestion becomes observable: downstream consumers can react differently to new vs superseded knowledge.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: triple-returning ingestion worker + event types.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: makes memory evolution auditable, matching CRX's evidence discipline.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: edge_operations.py resolve_extracted_edges docstring states the (resolved, invalidated, new) triple; Redis dedup cache merge code present.

PROBLEM: Pure vector retrieval misses exact/structural matches; pure keyword misses paraphrase; graph traversal alone misses unconnected-but-relevant facts.
MECHANISM: EDGE_HYBRID_SEARCH_RRF fuses semantic (embedding), keyword (BM25), and graph-traversal results with reciprocal rank fusion for edge candidate retrieval during ingestion and search.
INVARIANT: No single retrieval signal can veto a candidate the other signals rank highly.
FAILURE_MODEL: If one signal's index is stale, the others still return candidates; fusion degrades gracefully.
SECURITY_MODEL: Fusion is score-based; no signal injects content, only ranking.
SCALING_MODEL: Three sub-queries per retrieval; each top-k bounded.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX's vector projection is quality-degraded; a fused retrieval (vector + keyword + graph walk over the knowledge graph) is the recovery path the audit implies.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Retrieval recall improves without trusting any single index.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: requires maintaining three indexes or adapters.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium-high: recall gains, but only after write qualification is sound.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: EDGE_HYBRID_SEARCH_RRF config referenced in edge_operations.py search calls.

PROBLEM: Ad-hoc memory writes (extract-then-insert per fact) are racy, duplicative, and hide failures.
MECHANISM: _add_to_vector_store runs a phased batch pipeline: Phase 0 gather session scope + last messages; Phase 1 retrieve existing memories (top_k=10, identity-scoped); Phase 2 single LLM extraction call; Phase 3 batch embed; Phase 4-5 md5 hash dedup within batch and against existing hashes; Phase 6 batch insert + batch history append. LLM extraction failure raises LLMError (typed) instead of returning [] — the code documents that silent [] made 'LLM unavailable' indistinguishable from 'no facts'.
INVARIANT: One ingestion pass = one extraction call, one dedup gate, one batch write; failures are typed, never silent empties.
FAILURE_MODEL: Typed LLMError propagates to callers for retry/fallback; per-item insert fallback on batch failure.
SECURITY_MODEL: Identity-scoped retrieval in Phase 1 prevents cross-tenant contamination of the extraction context.
SCALING_MODEL: Batch embedding and batch insert amortize per-fact cost; dedup is O(batch + existing hashes).
CRX_ANALOG: CRX canonical workers: a memory-ingestion worker should be a phased, idempotent, batch pipeline emitting canonical events, with typed failures (never silently converting failure to empty success).
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory writes become atomic-ish, observable batches with failure semantics instead of per-fact fire-and-forget.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: reimplement as a canonical worker pipeline.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: the operational shape CRX needs for memory ingestion.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: mem0/memory/main.py _add_to_vector_store contains PHASE comments 0-6, raises LLMError on extraction failure, and md5 hash dedup against existing_hashes.

PROBLEM: Showing real memory IDs to the extraction LLM lets it hallucinate, leak, or forge IDs in its output.
MECHANISM: Before the LLM sees existing memories, real UUIDs are remapped to small integers (uuid_mapping[str(idx)] = mem.id); the model references memories by index; the code maps indices back to UUIDs when applying updates. The model can never emit, invent, or exfiltrate a real memory identifier.
INVARIANT: LLM-visible identifiers are always ephemeral indices; persistent identifiers never cross the model boundary.
FAILURE_MODEL: Index-out-of-range references are rejected at map-back time.
SECURITY_MODEL: Eliminates a prompt-injection-adjacent exfiltration channel for internal IDs.
SCALING_MODEL: O(k) mapping table for k retrieved memories.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX subagents receive task-scoped context; any internal IDs (event IDs, mission IDs) shown to worker agents should be remapped to ephemeral handles, mapped back by the runtime.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Internal identifier hygiene: models operate on capabilities/handles, not raw keys.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: remap at prompt-build time, map back at apply time.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: cheap defense against ID hallucination/forgery.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: mem0/memory/main.py builds uuid_mapping with str(idx) keys before generate_additive_extraction_prompt.

PROBLEM: Memories go stale (EAB detections, prices, personnel) but nothing retires them; manual deletion does not scale.
MECHANISM: Per-memory expiration_date (YYYY-MM-DD, validated at write, ValueError on malformed). _payload_is_expired compares against UTC today; search and get_all hide expired rows by default (show_expired=False opt-in). Expiration is data, not a background job — staleness is evaluated at read time.
INVARIANT: A memory past its expiration_date is invisible to default reads; the row is retained for audit.
FAILURE_MODEL: Malformed dates fail closed at write; unparseable stored dates are treated as not-expired (fail-open read, conservative).
SECURITY_MODEL: Expiration is set by the writer; readers cannot extend it (no API to bump expiration without update rights).
SCALING_MODEL: O(1) per-row date comparison at read/filter time.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX has no forgetting path (proven gap). Per-record expiration_date evaluated at projection time is the lowest-cost forgetting mechanism: no sweeper, no probabilistic machinery, fully auditable.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Staleness becomes a first-class, declarative property of a memory record.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: add expiration_date to memory schema + filter in projections.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: cheapest credible answer to the no-forgetting gap.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: mem0/memory/main.py defines _normalize_expiration_date, _payload_is_expired, and show_expired=False defaults on search/get_all.

PROBLEM: Memory evolution is invisible: who changed what, from what, to what, when.
MECHANISM: Every mutation appends to a history table via add_history/batch_add_history: (memory_id, old_memory, new_memory, event in {ADD, UPDATE, DELETE}, created_at, updated_at, actor_id, role). _update_memory preserves created_at, bumps updated_at, rehashes, re-links entities, and writes the UPDATE row with old+new values.
INVARIANT: No memory mutation without a history row carrying before/after values and the actor.
FAILURE_MODEL: History write failure does not roll back the mutation (logged); audit may lag but the current value is consistent.
SECURITY_MODEL: actor_id/role stamped per row; history is append-only (no update API for history rows).
SCALING_MODEL: One extra row per mutation; batch_add_history amortizes.
CRX_ANALOG: Maps directly onto CRX's event journal: memory mutations should be canonical events with before/after payloads, not silent row updates.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory becomes an event-sourced entity: current state is a fold over its history.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: history table + write discipline on every mutation path.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: auditability is a prerequisite for owner corrections and dispute resolution.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: mem0/memory/main.py _update_memory calls self.db.add_history with old/new values and UPDATE event; storage.py defines the history schema.

PROBLEM: Memory leaks across users/agents/runs when scoping is a convention rather than a constraint.
MECHANISM: Every vector operation filters on user_id/agent_id/run_id; _reject_top_level_entity_params forces scoping through filters= rather than loose kwargs; _validate_and_trim_entity_id rejects empty/whitespace-containing IDs and coerces ints at a single validation point so scoping is consistent across add/search/get_all/delete_all.
INVARIANT: No memory operation executes without an identity scope; identity validation happens once, at the boundary.
FAILURE_MODEL: Invalid IDs raise ValueError before any storage access.
SECURITY_MODEL: Tenant isolation enforced in the query filter, not in application logic above the store.
SCALING_MODEL: Filter pushdown to the vector store; no extra round trips.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX missions/workers need the same discipline: every memory read/write scoped by (mission_id, worker_id, tenant) with boundary validation, matching the deterministic-ID regime.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Isolation moves from convention to enforced invariant.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: adopt filter-scoping + boundary ID validation.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: prevents the most dangerous memory failure (cross-tenant leakage).
FALSIFICATION_TEST: mem0/memory/main.py: search_filters built from user_id/agent_id/run_id in _add_to_vector_store; _reject_top_level_entity_params and _validate_and_trim_entity_id defined and called.

PROBLEM: Pure semantic similarity under-ranks memories about the specific entities in the query.
MECHANISM: _compute_entity_boosts: entities extracted from the query are embedded and matched against a dedicated entity store (threshold >= 0.5, max 8 entities, thread-pooled); each matched entity's linked memories get a score boost in [0, 0.5]. Entity<->memory links are maintained on every add/update/delete (_link_entities_for_memory, _remove_memory_from_entity_store, _upsert_entity).
INVARIANT: Entity linkage is kept consistent with memory lifecycle; boosts are bounded so entities rerank but cannot override strong semantic matches entirely.
FAILURE_MODEL: Entity-store failure degrades to unboosted vector search (warning logged, empty boosts returned).
SECURITY_MODEL: Entity matching is scoped by the same identity filters as memory search.
SCALING_MODEL: One batch embed + parallel entity searches per query; top_k=500 entity candidates.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX's knowledge graph (0 approved nodes at audit) needs a retrieval path; entity-linked boosting is the bridge between the graph and the vector projection.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Retrieval gains an entity-authority signal independent of raw embedding similarity.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium-high: entity store + link maintenance on all mutation paths.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: meaningful recall gains once the entity graph is non-trivial.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: mem0/memory/main.py defines _compute_entity_boosts returning boosts in [0,0.5] and _link_entities_for_memory/_remove_memory_from_entity_store called on mutations.

PROBLEM: Long-term memory needs hierarchical organization, expiry, and combined semantic+exact retrieval — most stores offer one of the three.
MECHANISM: BaseStore: hierarchical tuple namespaces (('memories','{user_id}')), NamespaceMatchType prefix/suffix with wildcards, ListNamespacesOp; put(..., ttl=<minutes>) with per-read refresh_ttl; search(namespace_prefix, query, filter, limit, offset) combining vector query with exact key-value filters; batch() executes GetOp/PutOp/SearchOp/DeleteOp in one round trip; PutOp with value=None marks deletion.
INVARIANT: All reads are namespace-prefix-scoped; TTL is a property of the item, refreshed only on explicit request.
FAILURE_MODEL: TTL support is adapter-dependent; refresh_ttl is ignored when the adapter lacks TTL (documented, not silent).
SECURITY_MODEL: Namespace hierarchy is the isolation boundary; no cross-namespace queries.
SCALING_MODEL: Adapter-backed (Postgres/SQLite/in-memory); batch ops amortize round trips.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX runs on PostgreSQL already: the namespace+TTL+filter contract is directly implementable as a memory projection over ping_events without new infrastructure.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory addressing becomes hierarchical and expiring by construction.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low-medium: implement the store contract over existing PG.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: gives CRX namespaced, expiring, filterable long-term memory with zero new infra.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: libs/checkpoint/langgraph/store/base/__init__.py defines namespace tuples, MatchCondition, ttl on PutOp, refresh_ttl on search, and batch ops.

PROBLEM: LLM memory managers that can freely insert/update/delete will eventually delete something load-bearing.
MECHANISM: create_memory_manager / create_memory_store_manager take enable_inserts/enable_updates/enable_deletes flags; the base manager defaults enable_deletes=False (fail-closed); the store-manager variant defaults True but routes deletes through explicit (namespace, key) ops. Flow: retrieve relevant memories (query_limit) -> LLM analyze+extract against existing -> apply puts/deletes. MemoryPhase allows per-pass policy variation.
INVARIANT: Destructive capability is opt-in and explicit; the default manager cannot delete.
FAILURE_MODEL: LLM-proposed deletes are constrained to (namespace, key) pairs from retrieved items; unknown keys cannot be fabricated into deletions.
SECURITY_MODEL: Policy flags are operator configuration, not model-decided.
SCALING_MODEL: One retrieval + one LLM call per pass; query_limit bounds context.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX agent write authority: surgical, well-reasoned writes with hard boundaries — the flag triple is the executable form of that grant.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Write authority becomes declarative policy instead of emergent model behavior.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: three flags on any LLM memory-manager worker.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: fail-closed deletes are the cheapest safety upgrade for agentic memory.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: src/langmem/knowledge/extraction.py create_memory_manager signature has enable_deletes=False default; create_memory_store_manager applies final_deletes as (namespace, key) ops.

PROBLEM: Naive conversation summarization re-summarizes already-summarized content, compounding loss and cost.
MECHANISM: summarize_messages processes messages oldest-to-newest, summarizing once cumulative tokens cross max_tokens_before_summary; RunningSummary tracks summarized_message_ids and last_summarized_message_id so only never-summarized messages are processed on re-runs; tool-call/tool-result pairs are never split; max_summary_tokens is a budget estimate (enforcement is explicit via model.bind, documented as the caller's job).
INVARIANT: Re-running summarization over the same message list is idempotent: summarized messages are never re-processed.
FAILURE_MODEL: Token counting is approximate by default (documented); callers can inject exact counters.
SECURITY_MODEL: No external writes; pure function over the message list.
SCALING_MODEL: O(messages) per pass; bounded LLM input by max_tokens.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX worker transcripts / mission event streams need bounded compression for handoff; idempotent running summaries fit the resumable, checkpoint-friendly execution model.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Compression becomes a safe-to-retry operation instead of a lossy one-shot.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: port RunningSummary + idempotency rule.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: solid working-context compression primitive.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: src/langmem/short_term/summarization.py defines RunningSummary with summarized_message_ids and the only-unsummarized-are-processed docstring.

PROBLEM: Memory systems either remember everything (storage explosion, stale cruft) or only the newest (lose important-but-old knowledge).
MECHANISM: forgetting_curve(t, S) = exp(-t*S/5) over days since last recall. At load, each dialog is kept with probability = retention, otherwise deleted from the JSON bank (initial_load_forget_and_save). Retrieval reinforces: update_memory_when_searched bumps memory_strength += 1 and resets last_recall_date — recall is consolidation. Strength grows with importance and recall count, so frequently-used memories decay slower.
INVARIANT: Retention is a function of (time-since-recall, strength); reinforcement only happens through actual retrieval.
FAILURE_MODEL: Probabilistic deletion can drop something still valuable (accepted tradeoff); summaries are retained with their own strength metadata.
SECURITY_MODEL: Per-user memory banks (memory_bank[user]); no cross-user recall.
SCALING_MODEL: O(memories) scan at load; no background process needed.
CRX_ANALOG: The only source-verified forgetting implementation found (survey: 4/27 systems). CRX's no-forgetting gap: Ebbinghaus decay over (last_access, strength) is the principled complement to mem0-style declarative expiration.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Forgetting becomes a continuous, usage-driven process rather than a manual or TTL-only event.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: per-record (strength, last_recall) metadata + load/sweep pass.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: the reference implementation of learned forgetting.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: memory_bank/memory_retrieval/forget_memory.py defines forgetting_curve, probabilistic deletion (random.random() > retention_probability -> pop), and update_memory_when_searched reinforcement.

PROBLEM: Contradictory facts silently coexist in the graph; or contradiction handling rewrites history.
MECHANISM: Opt-in cognify task (contradiction_detection flag, default off): collects entities/events touched by the current ingestion, gathers their 1-hop fact edges (new + stored), asks an LLM which pairs directly contradict. Each contradiction is surfaced twice: a logged warning AND a contradicts edge carrying both facts + reason + confidence. Non-destructive (adds edges only), returns input unchanged, swallows own errors. Deterministic Entity:<name> node IDs make cross-ingestion contradictions land in the same neighborhood. Structural relationships (contains, is_part_of, made_from, exists_in, contradicts) excluded.
INVARIANT: Contradiction detection never mutates existing facts; conflicts become queryable graph data.
FAILURE_MODEL: Task swallows its own errors; ingestion proceeds even if detection fails. False positives add edges (visible, removable) rather than deleting truth.
SECURITY_MODEL: Candidate facts limited to touched entities' 1-hop neighborhood; LLM output constrained to a ContradictionList model.
SCALING_MODEL: Bounded by touched-entity neighborhood size and a fact limit.
CRX_ANALOG: Lower-commitment alternative to Graphiti invalidation: when CRX cannot adjudicate a contradiction deterministically, reify it as a contradicts edge (a canonical event) for later resolution instead of silently coexisting or destructively resolving.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Contradictions become first-class, queryable knowledge rather than hidden rot.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: contradicts edge type + opt-in pipeline task.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: the fail-safe contradiction posture (surface, don't silently resolve).
FALSIFICATION_TEST: cognee/tasks/graph/detect_contradictions.py docstring states non-destructive/adds-edges-only/swallows-errors; STRUCTURAL_RELATIONSHIPS excludes contradicts.

PROBLEM: Graph facts lack lineage: which document/chunk/pipeline-run produced this entity, under which tenant?
MECHANISM: Opt-in record_provenance task (PROVENANCE_TRACKING, default off): appends document->chunk->entity->relationship lineage entries to a relational provenance_entries ledger, one chained transaction per task invocation (manager.batch()). Ledger keys prefixed {dataset_id}:{raw_id} because entity IDs are deterministic (name-derived uuid5) — without the prefix, tenants sharing an entity name would share one version chain. agent_id stamped from ctx (user.email > user.id > 'cognee'). Missing ctx degrades to source_ref_key=None, never a raise; task returns input unchanged and swallows own errors.
INVARIANT: Provenance is append-only, transactionally batched per invocation, and tenant-prefixed; it can never break ingestion.
FAILURE_MODEL: Own errors swallowed; degraded entries (null source ref) rather than dropped pipeline.
SECURITY_MODEL: Tenant isolation via key prefixing; agent identity stamped per entry.
SCALING_MODEL: One ledger batch per ingestion task; relational store.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX already has causation/correlation lineage on ping_events; the ledger pattern (append-only, tenant-prefixed, never-breaks-ingestion) is the template for a memory-provenance projection.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Every memory fact becomes traceable to its source document and producing run.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: ledger table + pipeline seam after ingestion.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: provenance is a CRX constitutional concern; this is the field-tested shape.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: cognee/tasks/provenance/record_provenance.py: {dataset_id}:{raw_id} prefix docstring, single chained transaction, returns-input-unchanged + swallows-errors hard constraint.

PROBLEM: Memory retrieval ranking never learns from outcomes: memories that led to bad answers keep ranking highly.
MECHANISM: apply_feedback_weights: QA feedback (score 1-5 normalized to 0-1) updates the retrieval weight of the graph elements that produced the answer via stream_update_weight: w_new = w + alpha*(rating - w), clipped [0,1], 4-decimal rounding. Separate alpha for explicit vs implicit feedback (IMPLICIT_FEEDBACK_ALPHA_FACTOR). Elements that no longer exist are 'pruned' but the feedback row stays pending until FEEDBACK_WEIGHTS_MAX_ATTEMPTS bounds rescans. used_graph_element_ids come from recall(), spanning accessible datasets.
INVARIANT: Weights move by bounded exponential smoothing toward observed ratings; no single feedback can zero or max a weight (alpha in (0,1] validated).
FAILURE_MODEL: Missing elements -> pruned (pending, attempt-capped); failed writes reported per-id in outcome {applied, pruned, failed}.
SECURITY_MODEL: Feedback scores validated (int 1-5); alpha validated (0,1]; weights only move on elements the recall path actually used.
SCALING_MODEL: Per-feedback-item weight updates; bounded by used-element count.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX failure memory: worker outcomes (success/failure, owner corrections) should move the authority weight of the memory records that informed the worker — this is the only outcome-driven ranking loop found in source.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory authority becomes learned from operational outcomes, not just similarity.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: weight column + feedback ingestion keyed by used-memory IDs.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: closes the loop between failure memory and retrieval ranking.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: cognee/tasks/memify/apply_feedback_weights.py defines stream_update_weight with the EMA formula, validate_feedback_alpha, and the applied/pruned/failed outcome triple.

PROBLEM: One query embedding cannot serve both entity-level and theme-level retrieval well.
MECHANISM: get_keywords_from_query: an LLM splits the query into high-level keywords (for global/relationship retrieval) and low-level keywords (for local/entity retrieval); results cached in a hashing KV store; caller-supplied hl_keywords/ll_keywords skip extraction. Retrieval modes (local/global/hybrid/naive/mix/bypass) on QueryParam select the strategy per call; if ll_keywords is empty in a local-ish mode, retrieval degrades gracefully.
INVARIANT: Retrieval strategy is an explicit, per-query parameter — never an ambient default the caller cannot see.
FAILURE_MODEL: Keyword extraction failure or empty keywords degrade to the mode's fallback path, not to an error.
SECURITY_MODEL: Caller-supplied keywords bypass extraction (operator control); extraction output is normalized (split on newlines/commas/semicolons, phrases preserved).
SCALING_MODEL: One LLM call per uncached query for keyword extraction; cached thereafter.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX workers retrieving from the knowledge graph need per-call strategy selection (entity lookup vs theme search) rather than one fixed retrieval path.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Retrieval becomes a deliberate two-level operation (entities + themes) instead of a single similarity shot.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low-medium: dual keyword extraction + mode parameter on retrieval calls.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: recall gains for graph-structured knowledge.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: lightrag/operate.py get_keywords_from_query returns (hl_keywords, ll_keywords) with hashing_kv caching; base.py QueryParam has mode Literal[local,global,hybrid,naive,mix,bypass].

PROBLEM: Retrieved context grows without bound, blowing worker context windows and cost.
MECHANISM: QueryParam carries max_entity_tokens, max_relation_tokens, max_total_tokens (all env-overridable): hard budgets on entity context, relation context, and total query context (entities + relations + chunks + system prompt). The context builder truncates to budget deterministically.
INVARIANT: No retrieval call can exceed its declared token budget regardless of index size.
FAILURE_MODEL: Truncation is by budget priority, not silent; budgets are operator-visible configuration.
SECURITY_MODEL: Budgets are operator configuration; a query cannot raise its own budget.
SCALING_MODEL: O(retrieved) truncation; budgets bound downstream LLM cost.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX bounded automation: worker context assembly should carry explicit token budgets per memory class, enforced deterministically — the same fail-closed spirit as CRX's typed failure semantics.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Retrieval cost becomes predictable and enforceable per call.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: budget fields on retrieval requests + truncation in context assembly.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium-high: cheap, deterministic cost control for memory-augmented workers.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: lightrag/base.py QueryParam defines max_entity_tokens, max_relation_tokens, max_total_tokens with env defaults.

PROBLEM: Re-clustering the whole knowledge graph on every ingestion is prohibitively expensive; but delta runs must not collide with existing community IDs.
MECHANISM: Incremental indexing: create_communities runs hierarchical Leiden (seeded for determinism, max_cluster_size bound) on the delta; _update_and_merge_communities remaps delta community IDs by old_max + 1 (with parent remapping, -1 preserved) and concatenates with old communities. Community reports are regenerated per community (update_community_reports workflow).
INVARIANT: Community IDs are globally unique across full+delta runs; old communities are never rewritten by a delta.
FAILURE_MODEL: Deterministic seed makes clustering reproducible; ID remap is arithmetic, not heuristic.
SECURITY_MODEL: No user input in ID assignment; remap is a pure function of old max.
SCALING_MODEL: Delta-only clustering cost; merge is O(old + delta).
CRX_ANALOG: CRX projections rebuild from the event journal; incremental community merge is the template for growing derived knowledge (clusters, summaries) without full recomputation.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Derived knowledge structures grow append-only alongside the source journal.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: delta-aware merge for any derived clustering.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: important once CRX's knowledge graph is non-trivial.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: packages/graphrag/graphrag/index/update/communities.py _update_and_merge_communities remaps delta IDs by old_max_community_id + 1; create_communities.py takes seed.

PROBLEM: Ranking memories needs a cheap signal before expensive retrieval.
MECHANISM: Dual store: MemoryStream (raw timestamped entity mentions) and EntityKnowledgeStore (entity -> mention count, last-seen date). On each chat, extracted entities update both; the aggregated store (count x recency) is injected into the prompt as the entity salience signal. Deterministic, no embeddings, no LLM in the ranking path.
INVARIANT: Salience is a pure function of (mention count, last-seen date); recomputation is deterministic.
FAILURE_MODEL: No failure modes beyond storage I/O; degrades to empty list.
SECURITY_MODEL: Per-agent JSON files; no cross-agent reads.
SCALING_MODEL: O(entities) per update; trivial.
CRX_ANALOG: A cheap pre-retrieval salience signal for CRX workers: entity mention frequency/recency over the mission's event stream, computed without embeddings.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Adds a near-free authority signal to complement vector similarity.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: entity counter with timestamps per scope.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: cheap win, but no forgetting (see falsified claims).
FALSIFICATION_TEST: src/memary/memory/entity_knowledge_store.py: _update_knowledge_memory increments count and updates date per entity; chat_agent.py injects both stores into the prompt.

PROBLEM: Memory facts without write-time attribution cannot be audited, reproduced, or disputed later.
MECHANISM: Every augmentation write carries full attribution: entity id, process id, framework, LLM (provider/sdk/version/model), platform, storage dialect; IDs SHA-hashed (hash_id). Retrieval is entity-scoped with a two-stage funnel (dense_limit -> final_limit). WriteBatch groups mutations.
INVARIANT: No memory write without attribution; attribution is stamped at write time, never reconstructed.
FAILURE_MODEL: Attribution is structural (required fields); missing attribution fails the write build.
SECURITY_MODEL: IDs hashed; attribution metadata separated from content.
SCALING_MODEL: Attribution is constant-size per write; SQL-native storage with migrations.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX constitutional authorities (witness, evidence, observation): Memori's write-time attribution is the minimal viable form — every memory record should carry (producer, model, run, mission) at write time.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory records become self-describing evidence instead of bare facts.
INTEGRATION_COST: Medium: attribution fields on the memory schema + write-path stamping.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: prerequisite for trustworthy autonomous memory.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: core/src/augmentation/pipeline.rs build_payload constructs AugmentationAttribution with entity/process/framework/llm/platform/storage; hash_id used for IDs.

PROBLEM: Coding agents rediscover repository architecture, decisions, and procedures every session; vector DBs are heavyweight and opaque for this.
MECHANISM: Repository-local memory as plain markdown committed beside the code: MAP.md (architecture index), STATE.md (work state), sessions/ (session records), memory/decisions, memory/lessons, memory/rules, milestones.md. Session start injects a roll-up: titles of decisions/lessons + two most recent titles; full detail behind a ## Full Detail marker that is never injected (expand on demand). Stdlib-only Python, no network, no embeddings, no daemon at runtime.
INVARIANT: Memory lives with the code it describes (same repo, same commits); injection is title-first, detail-on-demand.
FAILURE_MODEL: Missing files degrade to smaller roll-ups; nothing fails hard.
SECURITY_MODEL: Local-only by construction (no network at runtime); secrets handled by the redactor (see CHAMNAN-REDACTOR).
SCALING_MODEL: Keyword retrieval over markdown; measured 223x token reduction vs naive re-reading on the author's corpus (unpublished; 28.8x on published corpus).
CRX_ANALOG: CRX already keeps MEMORY.md/daily logs/people pages — chamnan is the hardened form: decisions/lessons/rules as versioned files with a measured injection discipline, directly applicable to repository knowledge and procedural memory.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Repository knowledge becomes committable, reviewable, diffable memory.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low-medium: adopt the file layout + roll-up injection rule.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: decisions and lessons are the memory categories most valuable to autonomous engineering.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: docs/architecture.md describes memory/decisions, memory/lessons, the ## Full Detail marker never injected, and title-only roll-up.

PROBLEM: Untrusted inputs (repo content, tool output) projected into memory leak secrets; 'credentials are stripped' is usually an unmeasured claim.
MECHANISM: lib/redact secret redactor evaluated by tools/redactor_recall.py against a synthetic labelled corpus, publishing precision/recall as two numbers; documents its own ceiling honestly (no-network rule forecloses live-key verification, so precision is bounded). Redaction runs at ingestion into memory, before persistence.
INVARIANT: No string enters memory without passing the redactor; redactor quality is measured, not asserted.
FAILURE_MODEL: False negatives (missed secrets) are the residual risk, quantified by recall; false positives redact aggressively (safe direction).
SECURITY_MODEL: Deny-by-shape (synthetic test keys of real shapes); no live verification by design.
SCALING_MODEL: Regex-based; O(content length).
CRX_ANALOG: Directly addresses CRX's proven gap 'untrusted inputs projected into memory with no trust gate': a measured redaction gate at the memory-ingestion boundary.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Memory ingestion gains a trust boundary with quantified quality.
INTEGRATION_COST: Low: redaction pass at ingestion; adopt the measure-don't-assert discipline.
EXPECTED_VALUE: High: closes a named CRX security gap.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: tools/redactor_recall.py exists with synthetic POSITIVES corpus and precision/recall measurement; lib/redact.py implements the redactor.

SOURCE_PROJECT: OpenAI ChatGPT memory (documentation only, no source)
PROBLEM: Saved facts go stale; explicit-only memory misses what the user never asked to remember.
MECHANISM: Two tiers (per OpenAI help docs): (1) saved memories — user-visible, editable/deletable, model-updated; (2) chat history reference — background 'dreaming' process curates conversation history into memory state to offset staleness of saved memories. Temporary Chat opts out of both. Deleted-memory log retained up to 30 days for safety/debugging.
INVARIANT: Every memory is either user-visible-and-editable or background-curated; nothing is both hidden and authoritative.
FAILURE_MODEL: Staleness is the documented failure mode; dreaming exists specifically to offset it.
SECURITY_MODEL: User controls: per-memory delete, clear-all, full off-switch, temporary (memoryless) mode.
SCALING_MODEL: Industrial scale; details not public.
CRX_ANALOG: CRX's curated MEMORY.md + daily logs are the 'saved memories' tier; the missing piece is the background curation tier (dreaming/sleeptime) that consolidates runtime observations into curated memory without human prompting.
SEMANTIC_DELTA: Adds an autonomous curation loop between raw history and curated memory.
INTEGRATION_COST: High if built as a real background curation agent; the pattern is the value.
EXPECTED_VALUE: Medium: validates the sleeptime-consolidation direction; no source to harvest.
FALSIFICATION_TEST: No source available: verify against https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8590148 (saved memories behavior) and https://openai.com/index/memory-and-new-controls-for-chatgpt/ (chat-history reference). Treat third-party reverse-engineering claims (bio tool, block caps) as unverified.
